_about: Marcus Cornelius Fronto's correspondence (with Marcus Aurelius, Lucius Verus, Antoninus Pius and friends) in C. R. Haines's Loeb, the first English translation: vol. I (1919) and vol. II (1920) from first printings, raw IA OCR. Latin facing (some letters in Greek). Not minted.

fronto-haines-v1: The Correspondence of Marcus Cornelius Fronto with Marcus Aurelius Antoninus, Lucius Verus, Antoninus Pius and various friends, vol. I (Loeb; London: Heinemann, New York: Putnam, MCMXIX)
fronto-haines-v2: The Correspondence of Marcus Cornelius Fronto with Marcus Aurelius Antoninus, Lucius Verus, Antoninus Pius and various friends, vol. II (Loeb; London: Heinemann, New York: Putnam, MCMXX)
